verses.sanskrit:
जनमेजय उवाच।
              यदिदं शोचितं राज्ञा धृतराष्ट्रेण वै मुने। प्रव्राज्य पाण्डवान्वीरान्सर्वमेतन्निरर्थकम्॥१॥
verses.english: Janamejaya said : O (Muni), king Dhritarashtra must uselessly have lamented after having sent the heroic sons of Pandu into exile.

verses.sanskrit: कथं च राजपुत्रं तमुपेक्षेताल्पचेतसम्। दुर्योधनं पाण्डुपुत्रान्कोपयानं महारथान्॥२॥
verses.english: Why did the king thus permit his narrowminded son Duryodhana to excite the anger of those mighty warriors, the sons of Pandu?
verses.bhavadeepa: यदिदं शोचितमित्यादेरध्यायद्वयस्य तात्पर्यं सत्यसंरक्षणे कृते देवा मानुषाश्चानुगृह्णन्तीति ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: किमासीत्पाण्डुपुत्राणां वने मोजनमुच्यताम्। वानेयमथवा कृष्टमेतदाख्यातु नो भवान्॥३॥
verses.english: What was the food of the sons of Pandu while they lived in the woods? You explain to me-was it obtained from the woods or was it the product of cultivation?

verses.sanskrit:
वैशंपायन उवाच।
              वानेयं च सृगांश्चैव शुद्धैर्बाणैर्निपातितान्। ब्राह्मणानां निवेद्याग्रमभुञ्जन्पुरुषर्षभाः॥४॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : The best of men ate the produce of the wilderness and the (meat of) deer killed with pure arrows, which they first dedicated to the Brahmanas.
verses.bhavadeepa: वानेयं वनमवं नीवारादि कृष्टं कर्षणजं ग्राम्यधान्यम् ॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: तांस्तु शूरान्महेष्वासांस्तदा निवसतो वने। अन्वयुर्ब्रह्मणा राजन्साग्नयोऽनग्नयस्तथा॥५॥
verses.english: O king, both classes of Brahmanas (those worshipping with fire and those worshipping without it) followed these heroes wielding large bows while they lived in the wilderness.
verses.bhavadeepa: शुद्धेर्विषालिप्तैः ‘विषलिप्तेन बाणेन यौ हतौ मृगपक्षिणौ । तयोर्मांसं कलंजं तद्भुक्त्वा चान्द्रायणं चरेत्’ इति स्मृतेः । अग्रं हन्तकारप्रदेयम् ॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणानां सहस्त्राणि स्नातकानां महात्मनाम्। दशमोक्षविदां तत्र यान्बिभर्ति युधिष्ठिरः॥६॥
verses.english: There were ten thousand most illustrious Snataka Brahmanas, who had perfect knowledge in the matter and means of salvation and whom Yudhishthira fed in the woods.
He dedicated the black and other kinds of deer and clean animals of the forest to those Brahmanas, after having killed them with his arrows.

verses.sanskrit: न तत्र कश्चिद्दुर्वर्णो व्याधितो वापि दृश्यते। कृशो वा दुर्बलो वापि दीनो भीतोऽपि वा पुनः॥८॥
verses.english: None of those who lived with Yudhishthira in the woods looked either pale or diseased, lean or weak and timid or terrified.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रानिव प्रियान्भ्रातॄञ्ज्ञातीनिव सहोदरान्। पुपोष कौरवश्रेष्ठो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥९॥
verses.english: The best of the Kurus, the most virtuous Yudhishthira, supported his dear brothers as if they were his sons; and maintained his relatives, as if they were his own brothers.

verses.sanskrit: पतींश्च द्रौपदी सर्वान्द्विजातींश्च यशस्विनी। मातृवद्भोजयित्वाग्रे शिष्टमाहारयत्तदा॥१०॥
verses.english: The famous Draupadi first supplied her husband and the Brahmanas with food like their mother and at last she took her food herself.

verses.sanskrit: प्राचीं राजा दक्षिणां भीमसेनो यमौ प्रतीचीमथवाप्युदीचीम्। धनुर्धरा मांसहेतोर्मृगाणां क्षयं चक्रुर्नित्यमेवोपगम्य॥११॥
verses.english: The king going towards the east and Bhima towards the south and the twins towards the west or the north, put an end to the race of the deer in the forest (by daily killing them with their bows) for the sake of meat.

verses.sanskrit: तथा तेषां वसतां काम्यके वै विहीनानामर्जुनेनोत्सुकानाम्। पञ्चैव वर्षाणि तथा व्यतीयुरधीयतां जपतां जुह्वतां च॥१२॥
verses.english: Thus the Pandavas lived in the forest of Kamyaka for five years; but all the while they remained very anxious on account of the absence of Arjuna and were always busy with study, prayers and sacrifices.
